title: Grande Prairie RCMP: armed driver killed, ASIRT investigating
subtitle: Officers contacted EMS and STARS and began a series of life-saving efforts. The male was dead when EMS arrived. No officers were injured in the confrontation
article: Exactly what happened on a dirt road when Grande Prairie RCMP opened fire on a civilian in an incident that started just before midnight on July 18, will be reviewed by the Alberta Serious Incident Response Team (ASIRT).

At 11:50 p.m., police located an "erratic driver" in the city. When police attempted to stop the vehicle, the driver fled, heading for County of Grande Prairie roads, where more than four millimetres of rainfall earlier that day left the roads soft and muddy. The driver got stuck near Range Road 50A. As officers began to interact with the driver, he reportedly pulled out a firearm.
"During the confrontation, at least one officer discharged their service weapon and the suspect was struck."

Officers contacted EMS and STARS and began a series of life-saving efforts. The male was dead when EMS arrived. No officers were injured in the confrontation. Officers secured the scene as ASIRT began its investigation.

It's the standard to immediately notify the Director of Law Enforcement and have an outside agency investigate. However, the RCMP will independently review what happened, training policies, police response and the members' duty status, said Savinkoff.

Information is kept to a minimum in a situation like this, he added. The priority is the ASIRT investigation. Releasing information immediately following an incident could prove problematic for the investigators.

At the time of publication, there was no information about whether Grande Prairie Police Service officers were involved. GPPS currently works alongside their RCMP counterparts as part of the city's transition plan for its new service.
ASIRT, founded in 2008, has investigated prior police related shootings in Grande Prairie. At least four other incidents since 2015 have required the external agency.

December 20, 2023: RCMP respond to a northeast neighbourhood when a domestic dispute started playing out on social media. The suspect, Joshua Michael Frampton, was shot and injured by police after the female was extracted, and Frampton fired his firearm. ASIRT investigated the incident and released its report.

October 15, 2023: RCMP responded to a disturbance at an east-side residence. Wendel Houle was shot and killed when he confronted the RCMP officers with a firearm outside the residence. ASIRT took over the investigation, but no report has been published.

December 8, 2020: RCMP were responding to a domestic dispute. A confrontation in a gas station parking lot resulted in one male, unnamed, being shot and killed by police. ASIRT investigated and provided a public report.
January 2, 2015: A 19-year-old man was killed outside a convenience store. ASIRT investigated and released its report.
